Democrats have made early gains in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, flipping key Republican-held seats as they seek control of Congress. Indian-origin candidates Pia Dandiya and Suhas Subramanyam have secured victories, while several other Indian-American candidates, including Vivek Ramaswamy, are in the fray. With counting still under way, the results could reshape the balance of power in Washington and influence President Donald Trump’s remaining two years in office.
